key_highlights: ASX slides as oil nears $100/bbl on Hormuz escalation; rate-hike bets pressure big four banks (CBA, NAB, ANZ, WBC)
RBA deputy governor signals inflation still too high, reinforcing hawkish bias and rate-hike expectations
Iron ore in structural decline; BHP under pressure as commodity 'crumbles', weighing on materials sector
Gold sector active: Forrestania joins 2Moz club, Kaiser reloads Tassie inventory, Larvotto strikes NSW gold-antimony-tungsten
Santos gas cartel breaking, reshaping energy pricing dynamics for downstream consumers
Property sector faces 'GFC moment' domestically; NZ house price crash returns, signalling regional contagion risk
Qantas $35M redundancy payout signals ongoing structural cost pressure in transport/consumer sector
ATO opens tax enforcement front against Big Tech, potential revenue and compliance implications

sectors.trend: Iron ore in sustained downtrend; BHP and peers under severe pressure. Gold miners showing relative strength with multiple discoveries and M&A activity.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face margin compression. Gold names (GOLD.AX, NZG.AX, AVA.AX) and juniors (Larvotto, Aureka, Forrestania) attract capital rotation. Diversification away from iron ore exposure critical.

sectors.trend: Big four banks fall as oil-driven inflation fears revive rate-hike expectations. RBA deputy governor's hawkish commentary reinforces tightening cycle risk.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX face NIM pressure from higher funding costs and credit risk from property stress. Rate sensitivity elevates volatility. ATO enforcement (headline 34) may boost government revenue but pressures corporate earnings.

sectors.trend: Oil approaching $100 with Goldman $120 upside on Hormuz conflict. Santos gas cartel breaking disrupts domestic gas pricing. El Nino adds supply risk.
sectors.implications: WDS.AX, WLE.AX, SXG.AX benefit from oil spike but face geopolitical execution risk. Santos (STO.AX) faces pricing pressure as cartel breaks. Downstream consumers (WES.AX, CWP.AX) hit by input cost inflation.

sectors.trend: Australian property faces 'GFC moment'; NZ house price crash returns. Mortgage costs driving household stress and second-job participation.
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX, SPG.AX) face occupancy and valuation pressure. Property developers (DHG.AX, SRG.AX) at elevated risk. Housing affordability crisis constrains consumer spending.

sectors.trend: Qantas $35M redundancy payout; supply crunch jacking up car insurance; living standards collapse masked by public sector employment.
sectors.implications: QAN.AX faces structural cost overhang. Insurance (CGU.AX, WBC.AX) premiums rising. Consumer staples (WES.AX, WOL.AX) see defensive rotation but margin pressure from input costs.

sectors.trend: Limited ASX-specific catalysts. Global AI/pharma DNA demand (TWST) and quantum computing (IonQ) drive US-listed names but limited direct ASX spillover.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX, SGH.AX, WES.AX (health) remain defensive anchors. ASX tech exposure minimal; global AI narrative supports sentiment but not direct earnings.

key_themes: Geopolitical oil shock: Hormuz escalation driving $100+ oil, inflation re-acceleration, rate-hike repricing
Iron ore structural decline: China demand weakness, BHP strategic pivot pressure
Gold as safe-haven rotation: multiple ASX discoveries and M&A activity
Property sector stress: GFC parallels, NZ contagion, mortgage affordability crisis
RBA hawkish bias: inflation persistence, deputy governor signalling further tightening
Energy transition disruption: Santos gas cartel break, El Nino supply risk
Fiscal pressure: ATO vs Big Tech, public sector boom masking living standards decline

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Hormuz Strait escalation / oil supply shock
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge energy exposure; favour oil producers (WDS.AX, WLE.AX) over consumers; monitor Goldman $120 scenario for inflation pass-through
Reduce duration in rate-sensitive sectors (REITs, property developers); favour fixed-income and dividend payers with pricing power
Underweight BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX; rotate into gold and diversified miners; monitor China PMI and steel data

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Property sector systemic stress / NZ contagion
risk_assessment.mitigation: Avoid high-leverage property developers; monitor bank NPL data; favour defensive REITs with long leases
Monitor agricultural and energy supply chains; favour companies with diversified geographic exposure
Maintain gold allocation; monitor AUD/USD for safe-haven flows; avoid over-concentration in single-region exposure

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold miners and juniors on safe-haven rotation and discovery pipeline
opportunities.rationale: Multiple ASX gold discoveries (Forrestania 2Moz, Larvotto NSW, Kaiser Tassie) plus geopolitical premium support gold prices; Aureka $8.9M M&A signals sector consolidation

opportunities.recommendation: Tactical long on oil producers ahead of $100-$120 oil scenario
opportunities.rationale: Hormuz escalation and Goldman $120 upside create asymmetric upside for WDS, WLE; energy sector under-owned relative to oil trajectory

opportunities.recommendation: Favour defensive consumer staples with pricing power
opportunities.rationale: Inflation re-acceleration and living standards collapse favour WES, WOL with inelastic demand; insurance premium tailwinds from supply crunch

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce exposure to iron ore majors and property developers
defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore in structural decline; property faces GFC-level stress with NZ contagion; both sectors face earnings downgrades

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge rate risk in financials and REITs; increase cash/gold allocation
defensive_moves.rationale: RBA hawkish bias and oil-driven inflation raise rate-hike probability; banks and REITs most rate-sensitive

defensive_moves.recommendation: Monitor Qantas and transport sector for further cost overhang
defensive_moves.rationale: $35M redundancy payout signals structural issues; oil spike adds fuel cost pressure to QAN and logistics names

market_outlook.short_term: ASX 200 (^AXJO) under pressure from oil-driven inflation fears, rate-hike repricing, and iron ore weakness. Expect 3-5% downside risk in next 4-6 weeks. Gold and energy outperform; banks, property, and iron ore lag. AUD/USD likely under pressure from risk-off flows despite oil support.
market_outlook.long_term: 6-12 month outlook cautious. Iron ore structural decline caps materials sector recovery. Property correction may extend. However, gold discovery pipeline, energy transition, and potential RBA pivot if growth stalls offer medium-term entry points. Key variable: whether Hormuz conflict resolves or escalates.
